scope.thisKit: Sixteen orientation-specific 22.5-degree wall sectors forming an unbroken circle.
notIncludedInBaseKit: Runtime asset registration or world-placement migration
scope.geometryApproval: Conservative production candidate; final in-game placement still requires visual and collision review.

candidateCircle.centreSource: Actual hearth placement in migration-data/world-layout.json draft
candidateCircle.angleConvention: 0 degrees is north; increasing angles run clockwise; world y increases downward

headquartersClearance.method: Transform the saved placement-specific closed collision polygon by its frame width, height, normalized anchor and scale; measure every vertex from the actual hearth centre.
headquartersClearance.limits: This is an HQ polygon clearance check, not an exhaustive audit of all buildings, props, foliage, navigation or sprite overhangs.

existingPerimeterFits.input: Twelve endpoints of the six saved gate traces
All available vertices of the current eleven wall placement collision polygons
existingPerimeterFits.caveat: Includes inner and outer polygon edges; one non-solid original wall has no explicit collision polygon. Diagnostic only.

candidateRoadOpenings.status: Planning measurements only; no road variants are included in the base sixteen-sector kit.
candidateRoadOpenings.method: Intersect each registered painted road centreline polyline with candidateCircle. Add 60 world units on each side of the road and correct for its crossing angle to estimate a clear opening. Measurements use polyline segments, not the map renderer's quadratic smoothing.
candidateRoadOpenings.limits: Registered atlas road traces approximate painted gameplay paths. Visually verify the actual ground art, shoulders, terrain and player clearance before using these intervals in a world migration.
futureVariantRules: Preserve six road openings and no gate leaves.
Shorten every canonical sector intersected by an opening; an opening crossing a sector boundary requires two shortened neighboring variants.
Provide finished end posts at the true road boundaries.
Do not remove a whole 22.5-degree sector for every road: its approximately 648-world-unit arc is much wider than the road.
Do not retain old gate coordinates after enlarging the ring; use new road intersections.

engineConventions.groundProjection: Flat world x/y with uniform camera scale and translation; no global isometric ground compression.
engineConventions.placementAnchor: Normalized ground midpoint within each sprite canvas; do not use visual centre.
engineConventions.spriteRotation: Runtime rotation rotates the entire baked bitmap and its vertical timbers; create each orientation separately and place with rotation 0 and no flips.
engineConventions.collision: Placement-specific normalized closed polygons or open polyline paths are supported.
engineConventions.occlusionCaveat: Existing wall depth/fade code uses only the first straight segment. Curved walls need later depth/occlusion review.
engineConventions.slicingCaveat: Keep whole upright volumes. Radial cuts in screen space can bisect vertical timber faces.

nonAuthoritativeMapSymbol.reason: The source explicitly identifies this as a cartographic symbol that does not change gameplay walls, terrain or roads.

independentGeometryGuideReview.visualReview: Contact sheet and complete clay ring show consistent upright timbers and a continuous circular ground foundation.
independentGeometryGuideReview.limits: The assembled clay preview renders the combined 3D guide geometry with a depth buffer. It does not validate standalone 2D sprite compositing order or subsequent AI-painted registration. Final painted images need separate assembly and seam review.
